name_reason: Follows fd2_<verb>_<noun>_<qualifier> like sibling blits (fd2_blit_sprite_raw_with_header, fd2_blit_sprite_with_stride_loop). Accurately describes a nearest-neighbor sprite scaler (output scale_num wide x scale_den tall via fractional Bresenham accumulators on both axes) with transparent-zero skip (the _skip qualifier = source pixel 0 is not written). No Ghidra address residue in the name.
purpose: Bresenham-style nearest-neighbor sprite scaler that paints a scale_num-wide x scale_den-tall output block from an arbitrary src.width x src.height source sprite, skipping transparent (zero) source pixels.
logic_summary: Stores stride into scaler_loop_state[0..3] (dword) and scale_num/scale_den into globals; reads src width/height from the sprite header words (0,2) and sets src_row_ptr = hdr+4. Seeds both the vertical row accumulator and the output-row down-counter (scaler_loop_state[4] word) from scale_den. Outer loop per output row: vertical Bresenham advances src_row_ptr by src_width while row_acc < src_height (stepping by scale_den), then subtracts src_height (row_acc persists across rows). Inner loop per output column: horizontal Bresenham advances src_iter while col_acc < src_width (stepping by scale_num, col_acc restarts at scale_num each row), then subtracts src_width; if the sampled source pixel != 0 it is written to dst, else skipped. dst_buf advances by stride and the row down-counter is decremented until 0.
signature: void __cdecl fd2_blit_sprite_scaled_with_skip(uint32 sprite_hdr, uint32 dst_buf, uint32 stride, uint32 scale_num, uint32 scale_den)

params.name: sprite_hdr
params.semantics: Pointer to sprite header: ushort width (word 0), ushort height (word 2), then width*height raw pixel bytes (row-major); pixel value 0 = transparent. Pixel data starts at hdr+4.
params.reason: Matches body usage (reads words 0/2 as src width/height, +4 as pixel base) and sibling naming; no address residue.

params.name: dst_buf
params.semantics: Destination base linear address; row base advanced by stride per output row.
params.reason: Accurately names the destination buffer base; consistent with other blits in the file.

params.name: stride
params.semantics: Bytes to advance the destination per output row (stored in scaler_loop_state[0..3] and reloaded each row).
params.reason: Standard stride parameter; matches body usage and file convention.

params.name: scale_num
params.semantics: Output width in pixels AND the horizontal sample step (column accumulator increment). Stored in data_fd2_graphics_sprite_blit_scale_num.
params.reason: Correctly reflects its dual role as numerator/horizontal step and output column count; matches the documented Bresenham scaler semantics.

params.name: scale_den
params.semantics: Output row count AND the vertical sample step (row accumulator increment). Seeds both row_acc and the output-row down-counter. Stored in data_fd2_graphics_sprite_blit_scale_den.
params.reason: Correctly reflects its dual role as denominator/vertical step and output row count; matches body usage.

returns.semantics: No return value. Binary wraps the body in PUSHAD/POPAD and ends with a plain RET (EAX restored), so the decompiler return artifact is dropped; void.
